steps.text:
I wasn’t able to locate a Virginia DWR report that lists the number of National Forest Permits issued by each local jurisdiction for fiscal year 2020. A search of the DWR website and available PDFs (annual reports, permit‑statistics pages, and related documents) did not reveal a table or dataset that breaks the permit counts down to the member localities of the Central Shenandoah Planning District Commission. Because I cannot substantiate any locality’s permit count—very few localities had populations over 30,000 anyway, and no source provides totals exceeding 1 000—there is no evidence to answer the question.

**Result:** No member locality of the CSPDC with a population under 30 000 in the 2020 Census has documented >1 000 National Forest Permits issued in FY 2020 (data not found).
